desc:
🚗 Welcome to Break, Steal and Drive! 🏎️

🎮 How to Play:

🪓 Break crates to discover rare vehicles!
🏃 Steal vehicles and escape the guards!
💰 Collect vehicles in your base to earn cash!
⚡ Upgrade your speed and tools!
🚗 Unlock new zones and drive amazing vehicles!
🏆 Collect them all in the Index!

❤️ Like the game and join the group for free rewards!
